channel.title: On the Rise
channel.description: On the Rise is a weekly verdict publication on rising dev tools: honest comparisons with the data and method shown, not affiliate fluff.

item.title: Playwright vs Puppeteer: Which Should You Use?
item.description: Playwright vs Puppeteer compared honestly: browser support, auto-waiting, the test runner, scraping and PDF — with a clear verdict for each use.

item.title: Svelte 5 vs React 19: Which Fits Your Team?
item.description: Svelte 5 runes vs React 19 compiler: same problem, opposite answers. Bundle weight, ecosystem, hiring, mobile — and which one fits your next project.

item.title: Vitest vs Jest: Which Should You Use in 2026?
item.description: Vitest or Jest? The honest decision guide: Vite projects, TypeScript, ESM, React Native, and when migrating an existing Jest suite is actually worth it.
